VitalSignCard.purpose: Display a specific health metric (e.g., Heart Rate).
VitalSignCard.motion: On hover, slightly elevate and increase shadow. In elderly mode, no hover effect, larger tap area.

ElderlyModeToggle.purpose: Switch app layout between standard and elderly mode.
ElderlyModeToggle.style: A pill-shaped toggle, warm grey background, with a distinct sun/moon or young/old icon.
ElderlyModeToggle.motion: Sliding pill animation with a subtle background color crossfade.

AIReportSummary.style: Soft glassmorphism panel with a subtle gradient border. Typography is easily readable with high line height.
AIReportSummary.motion: Text reveals line by line slightly (staggered fade) when loaded.
